gjort: US round for the roof cover: 7 rows in the queue - 2 images and 5 videos. Both images are live; the same five videos as the last two days are still HELD, see below.

Image CaraShellRoof_US_OB_108_1 -> ad 120251634831160435 in ad set CARASHELL_US_OB, ACTIVE. This is the 'won't it just blow off?' objection, and the brief's hard rule survives translation: the ad shows and names the fastening - the strap clips into a hook, not a knot you're hoping holds - and never promises the cover cannot blow off. Metres converted the way the US product page itself does it: 2,5 m became 8 ft, 10,5 m became 34 ft.

Image CaraShellRoof_US_OB_110_1 -> ad 120251634835850435 in the same ad set, ACTIVE. This is the 'is it waterproof?' objection, and the words waterproof and water-resistant appear nowhere in it - the ad answers with the mechanism instead, exactly as the Swedish does: rain runs off the surface instead of pooling, and the silver-coated 210D oxford weave takes the sun, not the roof.

Both images read back by OCR after rendering: no Swedish word, no kr figure, no store name, and no number outside what each brief allows ($199, $249, $50, 20%, plus 8 ft and 34 ft on one and 210D on the other).
The Approved queue was checked as well: 60 rows, every one of them already carries a US ad. Nothing is lagging behind.

Market watch (new today, runs after the upload so today's ads are included): all 12 ad sets in the US campaign carry the feed-only placements, and the store reads as English to an American visitor - home page, both landing pages, the product page and the checkout, with the checkout defaulting to the US. Nothing had drifted, so nothing was changed.

0 HeyGen credits used. The five video rows stay in SE-ACTIVE to be translated, their Swedish and Norwegian versions untouched and no Notion status changed on them. They already carry the comment explaining the hold, so they were not commented again.
varningar: Placements: 16 781 kr went to Instagram Stories today and 2 570 kr yesterday, before the ad sets were switched to feed-only at 11:32 UTC today. That is money already spent, not a live leak - the watch confirms every ad set is feed-only now, so it should stop from here. Worth watching tomorrow's numbers to confirm it did.
Two of the five held videos (OB_103_H1, OB_104_H1) end on a BAVERBUTIKEN card. That is the usual case and the pipeline rebuilds the end card before upload - it is not why they are held.
The campaign still has two ad sets for the same angle, CARASHELL_US_GT and CARASHELL_US_G, splitting that angle's budget in the CBO. Nothing was touched - the owner decides which one counts.

The queue still cannot read the price automatically, because the campaign's inherited link is the listicle page rather than a product page. The price was read directly from the American product and landing pages instead: $199 from $249. Known carry-over, not a fault.
Meta shows PENDING_REVIEW / IN_PROCESS on a fresh ad for a while - normal.
